item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
## What's new
- **NotchKat keeps itself up to date.** It looks for a new version once a day and asks before installing it. Choose Check for Updates… in the menu bar menu to look now, or turn the daily check off in Settings › General.
This is the first version that can update itself. Install it from this disk image once; later versions arrive on their own.
